text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I knew it. It's much easier to read the qi
flow
during dirt races. ☆ That was an
amazing run!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The clear, radiant spring arrives, and my
task is
complete. Even so...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (Wooooo...)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(The qi is still faint, despite the race's
grade. That
means...)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Found it! A rupture in the dragon vein!
This is it! A
great river and a raging rapid
don't naturally
cross paths.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: ...Which means!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I've got a good grasp of my
aptitude and
ability now! ☆ I know what
I want to do from here
on out.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It seems that the dirt is where I
belong. It's
the best kind of race to
demonstrate the power of
feng shui!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's a shame she won't run in the
Japanese Derby,
but I was prepared to
arrive at this conclusion.
We should
focus on dirt now.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Feng shui resonates best with dirt. And
so...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Entering the Japanese Derby might not
be a bad
idea!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But I was completely unprepared to hear
this.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I realized why everything felt off today.
It's
because a dragon vein has been
severed.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
So, I can't just barrel ahead on dirt
willy-nilly. I
have to direct qi back into
dirt races from turf
first.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey explains her reasoning
with a
cheerful expression on her face.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Remember? My dream is to show people
the
wonder of feng shui and put smiles
on their faces.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
So, while dirt might be the best surface
for
demonstrating feng shui's power...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's far less popular than turf. It'd be nice
if
attention shifted to dirt outside the
big Classic
Triple Crown season...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
But I don't think that's gonna happen all
of a
sudden, no matter how well I do. So
to bring eyes
to feng shui, I've gotta go
give the people a
sample.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: That's the reason the dragon vein's flow has been severed. There's a disparity between demonstrating feng shui and spreading it.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
While some racers like Tarumae work
steadily to
gain recognition, and others
like Smart Falcon
work to promote
themselves...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: I'm not them. Using feng shui to carve out my path is my way of doing things.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: And, I found a really good method!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, it'll attract a great deal of
attention if
a dirt runner like me enters a
top-class turf race
like the Japanese
Derby.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If I run well, I'll manage to gain a lot of
attention,
right? Once all those people
become interested...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I can guide them to see races on dirt.
The Derby
is the entrance, and the dirt
is the dragon tunnel's
exit.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Here, look at the eight trigram map I
drew! It's
not about choosing between
black and white, but
rather a
combination of the two!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Japanese Derby is like a tributary
flowing
into the main river that is dirt
races. Her argument
makes sense and is
compelling. Furthermore...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her vision of the future is a complex
graph only
she—with her expertise in
feng shui—could
imagine.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
With that, I should definitely be able to
bring
about the three kinds of
happiness.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Yes! The first is...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Fans who, through watching dirt races,
learn
about feng shui can improve their
lives!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Next, by going from dirt to taking on the
Derby, I
can show the younger
generations a surprising
new path they
might not have thought possible.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Finally, there are people who will be
happy to
simply see me compete in the
Japanese Derby.
For example...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: You! ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That's how I see it, but really, this is just
me
satisfying my ego, or reaching for my
ideal.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Dirt remains my main focus, so if you
think I
should give up on the Japanese
Derby, I would
understand! Give it some
thought though, okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although she might qualify to enter,
honestly, I
think achieving a victory
would be tough. I have
to give this
careful consideration.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
However! If I'm going to lead loads of
followers
forward on my path... ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I'll have to go up against someone really
turning
heads on dirt. Someone like...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Tarumae, for instance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae recently scored two
consecutive
victories in regional dirt G3
races. She's fast
becoming a racer to
watch.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she keeps this up, she has a good
chance of
becoming the star of the dirt
track before the
year is through.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, what races do you think
Tarumae will be
entering around the end
of the year?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Champions Cup is one of only two
central
dirt G1 races currently being
held.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No serious dirt runner would skip a
chance to
compete, which makes the
odds of her running
incredibly high.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Got it! Let's set our sights on that next
then!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: All right! That's decided then! All that's left is to follow the path my compass indicates! Let's do it! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, with the end-of-year Champions
Cup in
her sights, Copano Rickey sets
off down a narrow,
overgrown path.
